Platinum will use commercially reasonable efforts to complete Certification Services within the target turnaround set forth in the Rate Card or applicable Work Order, under either Queue Tier. Such target turnaround times are good faith estimates only, are not binding commitments, and are subject to change based on facility capacity, equipment availability, and the scheduling needs of Platinum's other customers.
Time is not of the essence in Platinum's performance of any Work Order, and Client's sole remedy for delayed performance is as set forth in Section 11.3.

If Platinum does not complete a Certification Service within the outer edge of the target turnaround window stated in the applicable Work Order, Platinum will (a) provide Client a written explanation of the delay within five (5) business days, and (b) credit Client five percent (5%) of the fees for that Certification Service for each week of delay beyond that outer edge. If the delay exceeds eight (8) weeks beyond the outer edge, Client may terminate the affected Work Order on written notice and receive a pro-rated refund of fees paid for Services not performed. These remedies are in addition to, and do not limit, Client’s rights under Sections 8, 9 or 12 or the carve-outs in Section 10.

Tenant shall also be solely responsible for all accreditation, Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (“CLIA”), U.S. Food and Drug Administration (“FDA”), Occupational Safety and Health Administration (“OSHA”), radiologic-material, and other use-specific requirements and for all modifications required thereby. Tenant’s failure to obtain or maintain any such license, certification, registration, approval, or requirement shall not constitute a default by Landlord or entitle Tenant to any rent abatement or termination right.

Contractor shall conduct himself or herself at all times with due regard to public morals and conventions. If at any time during the Term of this Agreement, Contractor conducts himself or herself in a manner offensive to decency, morality or social propriety resulting in scandal or ridicule, or that reflects unfavorably on Company, Company’s products or the image of the Company’s “brand,” or that materially reduces the value of Company’s association with Contractor, Company shall have the right in its sole reasonable good faith discretion to immediately terminate this Agreement. If Contractor publicly disparages Company, its brands or its products Company shall also have the right to immediately terminate this Agreement. In addition, upon written request by Company at any time, Contractor agrees that it shall remove, within twelve (12) hours of such request, or by the end of the same business day where the request cites a legal or regulatory demand, all content and communications from its social media pages, its websites or other outlets that contain Company’s intellectual property or that refer to Company, the Company Property or any Company product, and shall keep such content down and not repost it.

During the Term, Company may, after the process below, terminate this Agreement only if Contractor (a) is convicted of, or pleads guilty or nolo contendere to, a felony or crime involving moral turpitude; (b) is charged with an offense involving violence or the safety of a minor; (c) engages in hate speech or unlawful harassment; (d) is banned from Instagram or TikTok for a material breach of applicable community standards; or (e) engages in conduct that becomes the subject of widespread public condemnation in national media. Before terminating, Company shall give Contractor written notice describing the conduct in reasonable detail, allow Contractor five (5) business days to respond, and confer in good faith regarding the notice. Pending that process, Company may require the Posts to be made private; if the notice is not sustained, the Fee remains unaffected. Unsubstantiated allegations, conduct occurring before the Effective Date, and Contractor’s good-faith expression of personal, political or religious views shall not trigger this paragraph. Neither party shall publicly disparage the other during the Term, except for truthful statements made in a dispute or to professional advisers. In addition, upon Company’s written request identifying a legal or regulatory requirement, platform action, licensor demand, or product-safety concern, Contractor shall remove or make private only the Post(s) created under this SOW within five (5) business days, except that a request identifying a genuine legal or regulatory requirement or product-safety concern shall be actioned by the end of the same business day. This obligation does not extend to Contractor’s organic content or content created for any prior or other campaign, ends upon expiration or termination of this SOW, and does not reduce the Fee if Company requests removal before the end of the ninety (90)-day live period.
Contractor shall preserve a copy of each such Post and its available analytics for twelve (12) months following removal.
This obligation shall survive the expiration or termination of this Agreement.
